QuestInfo.name: Forest Happenings
QuestInfo.0: Ask Tae Soo if he has any information on the suspicious group.
QuestInfo.1: Tae Soo has no idea why the Oda Army came to Mu Lung. He suggested you visit Do Gong in Mu Lung. Do Gong is at the Mu Lung Temple.
QuestInfo.2: Do Gong in the Mu Lung Temple has somehow already heard about the recent events. They don't call him master for nothing.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,536,020\nCan proceed to the Mu Lung Mojo quest

0.0: Perhaps they were just envious of the peachy aroma wafting through the air. Not everyone can whip up a killer harvest like this, you know.
0.1: Why not ask Do Gong in Mu Lung Temple? He keeps an eye on everything in Mu Lung.

yes.0: Mu Lung Temple is to the right of Mu Lung. Do Gong is the wisest of the masters. I'd be surprised if he doesn't have something worthwhile to say.

no.0: You're better off asking Do Gong for more info. I'm just a simple peach man.

1.0: No need to speak. I already know what you seek.

default.0: Punish the Peach Monkeys and Reindeer before they ruin the farm.
